impact: N-008 VAL-UI-014 requires a startup probe that shows a blocking install-hint modal when `xdg-desktop-portal` (or `pipewire`) is absent from the system. No such probe exists anywhere in electron/main.ts, electron/recorder.ts, or the renderer. The app will silently fail at capture time rather than surfacing a clear install hint at boot. Prevents T-010d acceptance and T-010e gate.
title: VAL-UI-014: dependency probe (pipewire/xdg-desktop-portal) not implemented
